scope: Single-variable source capture controls. No model or aligned appearance reference.
sequence: Run all conditions serially. All four views inspected; sample 1 and declared region receive focused inspection.
hash_convention: Canonical config = UTF-8 JSON with sorted keys and comma/colon separators. No whitespace or newline.
analysis: Compare each view against the original and new repeat in unchanged 8-bit RGB coordinates; retain whole-image and declared-region differences. These are source changes, not fidelity scores.
acceptance: Neither smaller pixel error nor an accepted capture establishes correct source visibility. Record whether the visibly missing supports/building surfaces persist. A cause requires a control that distinguishes it from other hypotheses.
